item.text:
“the stakes for our company has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our company have never been higher”

“federal goverment” >>> “federal government”

“more then ever” >>> “more than ever”

“has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named.]

“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”

“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”

“enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”

“directly effect every company” >>> “directly affect every company”

“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield is identified as R-OH earlier.]

“the registry in Section 5” >>> “the registry in Section 4”

“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty” >>> [CHECK: The original bill's daily civil penalty is given as $1 million. Confirm the amount and whether the amendment keeps or changes it.]

“who's support” >>> “whose support”

“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”

“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”

“28 members, 13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: These categories total 29 members, not 28.]

“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow” >>> [CHECK: Five senators are listed, but the preceding sentence says six are undecided.]

“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”

“Senator Kowalski, who withdrew his cosponsorship on October 2, has not committed to voting no; in a seperate interview, Senator Ames said he has not made a final decision either” >>> [CHECK: Clarify whether Kowalski and Ames belong in the undecided count and list; “seperate” should also be “separate”.]

“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached”

“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”

“the week November 16” >>> “the week of November 16”

“occured” >>> “occurred”

“The committee's hearing on the risks of advanced AI occured on September 30” >>> [CHECK: The votes section refers to a September 23 hearing. Confirm whether these are separate hearings or conflicting dates.]

“the treaty negotiations required by Section 6 would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The Section 6 summary gives an 18-month deadline, not two years; confirm whether negotiations must conclude or an agreement must be negotiated.]

“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”

“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”

“call there senators” >>> “call their senators”

“recieve updated talking points” >>> “receive updated talking points”

“Each of our five regional policy leads” >>> [CHECK: The opening sentence of this section says there are six regional policy leads.]
